notes.title: Final Update
notes.content:
Well, we have come to the end, after a very long time working on the development of this game, the last big final update has been released.
The game will no longer be developed, only updates that will be there are only "Bug Fix" this update includes.
---------------------------------------------------------------------
[list]
[*] New maps have been added for you to explore, full of treasures and dangers
[*] New 18 powerful enemies have been added to fight
[*] New 12 powerful Bosses have been added to fight
[*] New loots have been added in enemies, treasures and Quests
[*] New Quests have been added with unique rewards
[*] New items have been added, with unique atilities
[*] New game modes have been added, to facilitate gameplay
[*] New challenges and puzzles have been added with unique rewards
[*] New abilities have been added, with unique powers
[*] New rarity levels have been added
[*] New animations have been added to make exploration more interesting
[*] New death and victory effects have been added
[*] New game load has been added
[*] New Expert Skills
[*] Map improvement
[*] Combat balance
[*] Experience distribution balance
[*] Weapon balance
[*] Armor balance
[*] Balancing skills
[*] Boss balancing
[*] Loot balance
[*] Quest balance
[*] Class balance
[*] Pets balance
[*] Animations improvement
[*] Weather enhancement is now completely automatic and random
[*] Fix some Bugs
[*] Dungeon improvement
[*] Puzzle improvement
[*] Class Improvement
[*] and much more to discover
[/list]
---------------------------------------------------------------------
Also the mods for the game have been developed and released you will find them [url=https://rpics.itch.io/]HERE[/url]

notes.title: Crusade Project
notes.content:
How many times have you played a game and said "uhm here I would have done this" or you thought "if there was this sword" and you imagined "it would be nice to have a boss in an area of ​​the mountains"
this is how this game was born, imagining, while I was playing I imagined creating my own game where I could have the power.
BUT, why not give the players a slice of the power? Take the power of the developer too!
After much reflection I thought about starting a project, "Project Deitra" is a big game update.
Anyone who has ideas on how to change and improve the game, what to add, what to remove and modify, how, write them to me.
ideas must have:

[list]
[*] a title
[*] an accurate description
[*] a logic
[*] one or more functions
[*] usefulness inside the game
[/list]

---------------------------------------
[b][i]Please provide as much detail as possible, sending photos if necessary, this is an example.
(Boss, Mob, NPC, Pet or more)
Name: Pteridatil
Type: Boss
Level: 17-20
Zone: Camp of Slime
Drop: Pteril Sword 5% HP Potion 80% Gold 3-5k XP 300-780 Fly Gem 3%
Boss Respawn: 10 Min[/i][/b]
---------------------------------------
(Weapon, Armor, Accessoryor more)
Name: Holly Sword
Type: Weapon
Level: 10
Rarity: Epic
Drop: Any Boss 9%
Price: 10238 Gold
--------------------------------------
so you can create your own
[list]
[*] Zone (Map)
[*] Weapon
[*] Armor
[*] Any Equip Slot
[*] Pet
[*] Skill
[*] Boss
[*] Loot
[*] Treasure
[*] Achievement
[*] Quest
[*] Puzzle
[*] Item
[*] Game Class
[*] Seeds to grow
[/list]
etc etc....
Unleash your imagination.
------------------------------------------
FAQ
[olist]
[*] What do I get from it?
[u][i]You will be placed in Credits in the game.[/i][/u]

[*] How do I contact you?
[i][u]You can currently contact me via [url=rpicsgames@gmail.com]G-Mail[/url][/u][/i]
rpicsgames@gmail.com
[i][u]or via [url=https://www.instagram.com/gerom.98/]Instagram[/url][/u][/i]
gerom.98
[u][i]Telegram: @RpicStudio[/i][/u]

[*] How should I present my idea?
[u][i]Possibly create a World file or PDF if not a TXT with the clearest possible description.[/i][/u]

[*] What language should I write to you in?
[u][i]You can currently contact me in English, Russian and Italian[/i][/u]

[*] Do I need to have the game purchased?
[i][u]it is very preferable that you have a copy of my game otherwise it would not make sense that you give me ideas without knowing what it is, you can also have the DEMO as long as you reach the minimum level of the game 10 and minimum 5 hours of play, i need Screenshot.[/u][/i]

[*] How will I know you added my idea?
[i][u]I will discuss your idea with you and you will be the one to test it with a trial version if you wish.[/u][/i]

[*] How long do I have to wait for my idea to be added?
[u][i]This depends on your ideas that you send.[/i][/u]

[*] Can I change my mind?
[u][i]Yes, you can change your idea and modify it but you have a time limit of 3 days from sending.[/i][/u]

[*] How do I know you are doing what I imagined?
[u][i]You will be able to interact and test everything during and / or after the realization[/i][/u]

[*] Do I have to pay to do it?
[u][i]No, all you need to have is my game, DEMO or this version, no additional cost.[/i][/u]

[*] How long do I have to send everything?
[u][i]1 Month[/i][/u]

[*] Will you update the game for every idea you make?
[u][i]It would be bad to constantly update the game, don't you think?
I'll collect your ideas and put them into the game and then release one big update.[/i][/u]

[/olist]
---------------------------------------------------------------------
[i]Attention, it is not said that all the ideas will be included in the game, the ideas will be taken into consideration, evaluated and if suitable realized, with specific Credits inside the game, the ideas must be mature, well described and with usefulness within the game, ideas can be removed or rejected if deemed unsuitable, they can always be discussed with the developer, to have permission to insert their idea into the game, players must provide a screenshot of their level, a screen of the time played.
the level must not be less than 10 and the hours of play must not be less than 5 hours of play, moreover the screenshot of the missions and Bestiary must be provided, with a minimum of 10 completed missions and 20 creatures unlocked.
It wouldn't make sense to send me ideas about a product you've never had or have never seriously played with.[/i]

notes.title: Fix Bug update
notes.content:
[h1]---A big update has been released which includes several things including---[/h1]
[list]
[*] "Lud" weapons of all categories have been removed from Crafting, as they caused a bug with some Skills causing instant death of all enemies
[*] The description of the [Craft] category weapons has been updated, providing as much product details as possible
[*] The options have been updated by adding more than 100 different sounds to choose from
[*] Heliot Pet has been updated and fixed, now does not die in lava and does not trade into water during Dragon form.
[/list]

[h1]--- Fixed some bugs, including ---[/h1]
[list]
[*] Slimes have been fixed, now after level 5, slimes do not give DP indefinitely
[*] Correction of some maps
[*] Budget of Boss Slime
[*] Fix the speed potion, now it doesn't make you immortal
[*] Maze correction, now easier
[*] Spider Pet fix, now does not interfere with [Crafting] category weapons
[/list]

[h1]--- Graphic update--[/h1]
some graphics have been updated, including icons and trees.
[h1]--- New Treasure--[/h1]
now the world is richer in treasures and new items.
